title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 11: Athaliah's reign, the hidden prince Joash and the covenant made by Jehoiada the priest.

questions.text: What did Athaliah do when she saw that her son was dead?
questions.explanation: When Athaliah saw that her son Ahaziah was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring.

answers.text: She fled to the house of Baal
She made peace with Jehu
She set her grandson on the throne
She destroyed all the royal offspring

questions.text: Who stole Joash away from among the king's sons who were slain?
questions.explanation: Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram and sister of Ahaziah, took Joash and hid him with his nurse from Athaliah.

answers.text: Athaliah, the mother of Ahaziah
Jehosheba, the sister of Ahaziah
Azubah, the daughter of Shilhi
Jehoiada the priest

questions.text: Where was Joash hidden while Athaliah reigned over the land?
questions.explanation: Joash was with Jehosheba, hidden in Yahweh's house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.

answers.text: In the land of the Philistines
In the king's house in Samaria
In Yahweh's house
In a cave in the wilderness

questions.text: Whom did Jehoiada fetch and bring into Yahweh's house in the seventh year?
questions.explanation: In the seventh year Jehoiada fetched the captains over hundreds of the Carites and of the guard, and showed them the king's son.

answers.text: The captains over hundreds of the Carites and the guard
The elders and prophets of Jerusalem
The priests and Levites of the high places
The princes and judges of Judah

questions.text: What did the priest give to the captains over hundreds?
questions.explanation: The priest delivered to the captains over hundreds the spears and shields that had been king David's, which were in Yahweh's house.

answers.text: New swords made by the smiths of Judah
The bows and arrows of the king's guard
The chariots and horses of Ahaziah
The spears and shields that had been king David's

questions.text: What did the people do after the king's son was crowned and anointed?
questions.explanation: They made him king and anointed him, clapped their hands and said, 'Long live the king!'

answers.text: They bowed down and offered a sacrifice
They clapped their hands and said, 'Long live the king!'
They tore their clothes and wept aloud
They went out to fight against Athaliah

questions.text: What did Athaliah cry out when she saw the king standing by the pillar?
questions.explanation: Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, 'Treason! Treason!'

answers.text: Treason! Treason!
Help, my lord!
Kill the boy!
Guard the gate!

questions.text: Why did Jehoiada have Athaliah brought out between the ranks?
questions.explanation: The priest said, 'Don't let her be slain in Yahweh's house,' so the captains brought her out between the ranks.

answers.text: She was to be judged before the people
She was to be sent away to Samaria
She was not to be slain in Yahweh's house
She was to be kept in the king's prison

questions.text: Who was killed before the altars in the house of Baal?
questions.explanation: All the people of the land broke down the house of Baal and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

answers.text: Mattan the priest of Baal
Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah
Bidkar the captain of Jehu
Amon the governor of the city

questions.text: How old was Jehoash when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: The chapter ends by saying that Jehoash was seven years old when he began to reign.

answers.text: Six years old
Seven years old
Twelve years old
Sixteen years old
